    01 A little about me

    A builder’s curiosity. A leader’s perspective.

    I’m Hassan, based in Oslo. My work brings together AI, software platforms, business automation, and technical leadership.

    I connect product thinking with hands-on architecture: understanding the problem, designing the system, and making the pieces work together. My background spans ERP and CRM integrations, Microsoft Power Platform, and AI-enabled workflows.

    Where I focus — connecting intelligence with everyday work

    • AI & agentic systems

      AI agents, connected tools, and knowledge-driven workflows.

    • Business automation

      ERP, CRM, and Power Platform integrations that connect operations.

    • Product & technology

      Product strategy, software architecture, and hands-on delivery.

    05 What I’m thinking about

    The interesting part of AI is what happens next.

    I share thoughts on practical business AI, healthcare and MedTech, automation, and the decisions that turn experiments into useful products.

      • Agents are most useful when they plug into the ERP, CRM and Power Platform tools teams already use.
      • I design clear approval points, so a person signs off before anything important happens.
      • Start with one workflow, measure it, then expand.
      • At Medioteq I work on AI-driven health intelligence.
      • Clinical settings need trust, privacy and fit with existing systems before they need clever models.
      • The goal is support for clinicians and operations, not replacement.
      • Every architecture decision is also a product and business decision.
      • I translate business goals into technology roadmaps teams can deliver.
      • Good leadership keeps experiments moving toward useful products.
    Read my thoughts on LinkedIn ↗
    06 AI workshops for leaders

    Step into the age of AGI. With a plan, not a hype cycle.

    I'm Hassan Nasr, CTO at Medioteq AS. I run hands-on workshops for CEOs and leadership teams who want to understand advanced AI and agentic systems, and turn them into decisions, roadmaps and working pilots. I bring experience from AI architecture in health and enterprise software across Norway, the Gulf and Egypt.
